environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on an EC2 instance (m5.large) in a public subnet with an Elastic IP. The instance runs with IAM role 'SessionServiceRole' which has AdministratorAccess policy attached. Security group allows inbound on port 3000 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application uses node-serialize@0.0.4. No SCP applied to the account. The instance has outbound internet access via IGW.
